title: MCP VCR Suite Manifest
description: JSON Schema for validating suite.yaml files in MCP VCR community test collections.

server_package.description: Informational reference to the server package/repo.

transport.description: Transport mechanism expected by the suite.

ignore_fields.description: Optional list of JSON paths to exclude from comparison (e.g. dynamic timestamps).

transcripts.description: Ordered list of transcript filenames relative to the suite directory. Must not escape directory.
